description: Source code for the OAuth class in PHPMailer, implementing OAuth2 authentication wrapper using League's oauth2-client package.

classes.name: OAuth
classes.description: OAuth2 authentication wrapper class for PHPMailer, managing OAuth tokens and credentials.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes OAuth with provided options including provider, user email, client secret, client ID, and refresh token.

methods.name: getGrant
methods.description: Returns a new RefreshToken object for obtaining new access tokens.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a new AccessToken from the provider using the refresh token.

methods.name: getOauth64
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded OAuth token string, refreshing the token if expired.
